title: This was insane!!  #Grease #Immersivetheatre #secretcinema #musicals ...
transcript: Did you know that there is currently an immersive production of Grease happening in London it's the newest experience from Secret Cinema and brings you into the world of the Grease movie When you get there there is a giant fairground at your disposal with rides and games and food for you to enjoy to your heart's content these are paid add ons but if you would like to experience them I would definitely recommend getting there early as it can get pretty crowded right before showtime and the lines can get pretty long but once the movie starts you are ushered inside Rydell High into this giant playing space where the events of the movie are happening literally all around you there are also opportunities to interact with the characters from the film and you may even be invited up on stage to participate in some of the scenes if you are someone who likes these kinds of interactions I would definitely recommend coming dressed up ideally as a Pink Lady or T bird as I did notice the people who were dressed up were getting more attention from the actors the best way to experience this is by standing and walking around the space however there are places for you to sit if you need to but seating is pretty limited so that's something to keep in mind if you do have mobility issues then of course at the end everyone comes back out to the fairgrounds for the finale they're dancing literally all around you it is the coolest thing if you are a fan of immersive theatre or the movie musical grease I would highly recommend checking this out and if you have any questions about how it works you can ask me in the comments
